Additional check: the AGM 2025 PDF gives the identical "2010 - 2025" bracket for the committee tenures of all three other 2010-founding board members (Troitskiy, Korzhev, Volchek) as well, whereas Ilin is expressly listed as a "new Director" in that same document (unlike the other three, marked "reappointment") and was, per the 2024 local annual report, only an external non-director consultant, not a 2010-era board member. This makes it likely the AGM document reused the same boilerplate 2010-2025 bracket for all disclosed committee members rather than tracking Ilin's individual start year, while the live board-bio page differentiates him specifically with a distinct 2012 figure. On this reasoning, start_year was corrected to 2012 and the rejected 2010 AGM figure is kept and cited (not deleted) with this explanation, per project convention -- this is a reasoned, source-backed judgment, not a certainty. Also: O'KEY committee and non-exec-director entries had null GICS despite being the ticker's own already-classified company; filled with Consumer Staples/Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name). Bounded gap-follow-up attempt on the 'JSC Dorinda; LLC O'KEY; O'KEY MA Sarl; DA! validation_notes:
Processed 6 CSV people for ticker OKEY. Checked 2 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/OKEY: the 2024 annual report and 2024 consolidated financial statements. Completed 6 person-level research rounds. Education was found for all six CSV people, but no confirmed academic degrees, research experience, academic publications, patents or h-index were found for the target people. Key uncertainty: the CSV row for Andrey Krishnev is marked as 2025-current and is not a 2024 CEO fact; the confirmed 2024 General Director/CEO-level person is Konstantin Arabidis. The 2024 local Board was Heigo Kera, Dmitriy Troitskiy, Dmitriy Korzhev, Boris Volchek and Mikola Buynytsky; Heigo Kera and Mikola Buynytsky were not added because they are absent from the CSV. Konstantin Arabidis and Ilya Ilin are current/2025 directors, not 2024 Board directors. Weak or secondary sources used: Retail.ru, AdIndex, Synergy Online, Executive.ru, TAdviser and DP.ru; they were used mainly to corroborate career and education where official biographies were incomplete. Excluded namesakes included academic/scientific Ilya Ilin/Ilyin profiles, a Soviet cinematographer named Boris Volchek, and unrelated Dmitry Troitsky/Troitskiy profiles. Search considered complete because all local OKEY files were checked, official O'KEY sources and AGM materials were read, education/career/science/name-variant searches were run in Russian and English, and a second pass using discovered employers/universities did not yield higher-quality conflicting facts.
